name: Tamai Azusa
source:
>High school student
>Helps at a cafe which is also a surf shop

Azusa is a high school student who is lively on all occasions. 

She has moved to the town from a big city along with her parents, who loves the sea.

Her parents run a joint surfing shop with a cafe, to which she usually helps as a poster girl. She has a very bright personality and can get along well even with first time customers. Her hobby is surfing and she enjoys it anytime she doesn't have to help in the cafe.

It's hard to say that her family business is thriving, so she's thinking of a method to increase the number of tourists visiting. However, she's strongly against any heavy works by the seaside, afraid of sea pollution.

She's a resident of Umitsubame Town.

[Translated from [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/natsuyo/character6.html]Official Site[/url]]
